name: Fancy Pickled Eggs
description: A variation of pickled eggs with beets, giving them a distinctive purple color and sweet flavor.

recipeInstructions.text: In an enamel or stainless steel saucepan, combine all ingredients except eggs and onion rings.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large glass jar, alternate layers of eggs, beets, and onion rings.
Pour the heated liquid into the jar, ensuring all layers are covered.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Will keep in the fridge for 2 weeks.

keywords: pickled eggs, beets, appetizer, purple eggs

_similar.name: Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: Tangy pickled eggs made with vinegar, mustard, and spices, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the vinegar, water, mustard, salt, pepper, and onion pieces in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the hard-boiled eggs.
Let the eggs stand in the pickling liquid for 5 days before serving.

_similar.keywords: pickled eggs, tangy snack, preserved eggs

_similar.name: Plain Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: A simple recipe for pickled eggs with a tangy cider vinegar brine and sliced onions.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except eggs and onion rings in a stainless steel or enamel pot.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large jar, alternate layers of eggs and onion rings.
Pour the heated liquid over the eggs and onions, ensuring all are covered.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Will keep in the fridge for 2 weeks.

_similar.name: Hard Boiled Eggs/Devilled Eggs
_similar.description: A classic deviled egg recipe with a creamy yolk filling, garnished with paprika and optional olive slices.

recipeInstructions.text: Place the eggs in a covered saucepan with enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a rapid boil, then turn off the heat and let stand for 15 minutes.
Cool the eggs by filling the pot with cold water and changing it frequently until the eggs are cool.
Remove the shells and rinse the eggs to remove any bits of shell.
Slice the eggs in half lengthwise and carefully scoop out the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with a fork or pastry blender until smooth.
Add mayonnaise and mix until the yolks reach a creamy consistency. Optionally add mustard, chives, and pickle relish to taste.
Scoop the yolk mixture back into the egg white halves.
Garnish with paprika and/or olive slices as desired.
Chill the deviled eggs until ready to serve.

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Glazed Cottage Roll
_similar.description: A sweet and savory glazed cottage roll baked with a mustard and brown sugar crust.

recipeInstructions.text: Remove outer wrapper from cottage roll. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Add bay leaf, cloves, garlic and onion.
Bring to a boil, cover pan and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 1½ to 2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°F (75°C).
Lift meat from water and remove netting. Place in shallow pan or casserole dish.
Blend mustard and brown sugar together. Spread over cottage roll.
Bake in 425°F (220°C) oven for 15 minutes, basting occasionally, until glaze is set.

_similar.keywords: glazed cottage roll, baked ham, sweet glaze
